sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative food photograph for a home cooking recipe catalog. Photorealistic editorial food photo, landscape 3:2. Simple homemade snack on light ceramic plate or bowl, 45 degree overhead view, soft daylight, neutral light stone tabletop. Natural colors, real homemade textures, all important food in central 80 percent with comfortable margins for responsive cropping. No people, hands, utensils, labels, logos, watermarks, packaging or decorative props. Show only named ingredients without extra garnish or side dishes. Dish is clearly visible and inspectable.

images.subject: Eight small flat baked chopped chicken patties, lightly golden outside with visible tiny orange carrot flecks and fine oat texture, on a plate. One patty cut open to reveal fully cooked opaque white chicken, no pink meat. Rustic spoon-formed shape, not breaded or deep fried. No herbs, sauce, vegetables alongside or garnish.

Six small unwrapped baked egg muffins on a plate. Golden yellow fully set egg, finely chopped green broccoli florets, yellow corn kernels and modest pale melted cheese, no flour dough. Slightly sunken homemade egg muffin tops. No bacon, tomato, herbs, paper wrappers or garnish.

A modest pile of thin homemade square cheese and oat crackers about four centimeters wide, evenly light golden with fork holes and visible small oat flakes. Plain crackers without seeds, not sandwich cookies. Light ceramic plate, no dip, herbs, extra cheese, nuts or garnish.

Six small soft rectangular baked banana oat bars about 1.5 centimeters thick, visible fine oats and a few raisins, light golden beige homemade texture. Peanut butter mixed into the batter, no whole nuts. Simple plate, no chocolate, syrup, sugar dusting, banana garnish or decorative props.

Two small wide light ceramic bowls of smooth dark brown milk cocoa pudding, spoonable thick gently glossy surface, no molded shape. Modest portions, plain tops without decorations. No cream, chocolate shavings, berries, mint, nuts, cookies or utensils.

Four sturdy green lettuce leaf cups on a plate, filled with cooked canned white beans, yellow corn kernels and small red tomato cubes with a modest thick plain yogurt dressing and tiny paprika flecks. No rice, chicken, avocado, cheese, cucumber, chopped herbs or garnish.

Four wide raw red sweet pepper wedges shaped as boats, filled with finely chopped ready imitation crab sticks with red and white edges, finely grated pale cheese, thick plain yogurt and tiny dill flecks. Fresh crisp pepper, cold filling. No rice, whole shrimp, real crab claws, mayonnaise drizzle, lettuce or garnish.

Two small wide shallow plain ceramic bowls, each containing a modest portion of fluffy fine cooked couscous, plump ready chickpeas, finely diced cucumber with green skin and red tomato cubes, very light lemon oil dressing. Not large pearl couscous. No feta, raisins, peppers, herbs, avocado, bread, lemon wedges or garnish.
